name: @agendex/desktop
description: Agendex desktop app (Electron). Bundles code from packages/ee (Agendex Enterprise License, see packages/ee/LICENSE) and AGPL-3.0 code.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n vite,electron -c green,cyan "bun run --cwd ../ee dev:client" "cross-env AGENDEX_RENDERER_URL=http://app.agendex.localhost:5174/dashboard electron-vite dev --watch"
scripts.build: bun run --cwd ../ee build && node ../../scripts/build-ui-bundle.mjs --stamp-only && electron-vite build
